feeds.title: Anne Babu & Company Advocates
feeds.description: Anne Babu & Company Advocates has a blog that provides articles on the casual employees, Confidentiality, data protection, recruitment, and more law company law-related topics. They offer the highest form of legal services in their areas of focus.

feeds.title: Kenyan Lawyer
feeds.description: Cyrus is a commercial, property, and corporate lawyer practicing as such in a leading commercial law firm in Nairobi, Kenya. Head to their bloga and read on topics such as Duties and Responsibilities of a Company Director, shareholder agreements, Buying Land or Property in Kenya and more related subjects.

feeds.title: Mutie Advocates Blog
feeds.description: We are a boutique law firm established in Nairobi. Our main areas of expertise are in Technology, Data Protection, IP, and Corporate and Commercial Law. We aim to deliver bespoke and high-quality services to our clients. head to our blog and read about our past cases, Kenya laws, acts, key policies and more.

feeds.title: Kelin Kenya News
feeds.description: The Kenya Legal & Ethical Issues Network on HIV and AIDS (KELIN) believes in a world where no one lives in fear or oppression; where all have access to a decent standard of healthcare and life; a world where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. Their mission is to promote and protect health-related human rights for all. Read their blog that shares information about the NGO's activities, ongoing projects, the latest news and updates.

feeds.title: Mugambi Laibuta Blog
feeds.description: The Mugambi Laibuta Blog provides informtion about data protection, rules and regulations in Kenya, acts, and other informative articles. The author of the blog Mugambi is currently undertaking his PhD(Law) at the University of the Witwatersrand, South Africa. His PhD focus area is the right to privacy and data protection in Kenya.

feeds.title: ArtLaw Kenya Blog
feeds.description: The ArtLaw Kenya Blog features articles on business laws, contract signing, courts, arts, cultures and more. Started in June 2017, ArtLaw's team is currently made up of 7 members, comprising legal, business and arts practitioners and writers. Their aim is To bridge the gap between artists and their accessibility to legal advice.

feeds.title: Umsizi LLP Blog
feeds.description: Umsizi LLP is a firm of Advocates, Governance Advisors, Corporate Secretaries and Dispute Resolvers driven by several passions: to provide practical and timely legal solutions to entrepreneurs, innovators, and disruptors in various sectors. Read our blog which cover topics such as the corporate sector, government-related laws, employment law, family law and more.

feeds.title: Babu Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: Babu Law Firm specializes in the legal process involved in buying, selling or remortgaging a property. Follow their bloga and learn about the rules and regulations in Kenya, their court judiciary system related to real estate and property, property related acts, land transactions and more.

feeds.title: Begi's Law Offices & Chambers Blog
feeds.description: Follow Begi's Law Blog covers important topics such as laws, taxes, government policies, acts, immigration policies, commercial law & corporate law advisory and similar subjects.BLOC is a law practice that is aimed at personalizing the practice of law in satisfying the needs of the client.

feeds.title: Kenya Law Blog
feeds.description: Kenya Law Blog provides universal access to public legal information by monitoring and reporting on the development of jurisprudence for the promotion of the rule of law. They plan to be the lead provider of public legal information for an enlightened society.
